depiction.primary_object: outlined bust of a person, head and shoulders
modifiers: two concentric curved wave arcs to the upper right facing inward toward the head
depiction.composition: front-facing user silhouette on the left with incoming wave arcs on the right

readings.meaning: speaking, voice command, or talking aloud
audiology, hearing aid, or ear check
contactless or proximity sensor on a person

ambiguity: Because the larger arc is closer to the head and the smaller arc is further out, the waves literally point inward (listening/receiving), but at small sizes it is almost indistinguishable from outward sound waves (speaking/voice).

modifier_semantics.modifier: two curved wave arcs oriented toward the head
modifier_semantics.meaning: incoming sound, audio, voice, or wireless signal

task_intents: book or attend a hearing test

reasoning: Shows a person's head and shoulders with sound/signal arcs beside the head, immediately evoking speaking aloud, voice input, or listening/hearing. It fits tasks around rehearsing speeches, language listening or pronunciation practice, voice recording, and hearing care, though at small sizes it closely resembles the reverse-wave 'user speaking' glyph.
